attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent capsule stretch.** Columns 0 to 12, `hypothetical protein` to `iclR`, are spine in 97 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 42% of calls. The model names 89 to 99.6% there, fewest at `yjbD`, 89%, and hesitates most at `pepE`, 0.61 bits.

**The first fork is at column 13**, in a region of plasticity in 42% of calls, the most plastic column of the window; the model names 76% and hesitates 0.66 bits, the most hesitant column. Its branches carry a PTS transporter, `espL4` and an IS1-like transposase. Then columns 14 to 18, `aceK` to `yjaB`, are spine, [[glyoxylate cycle and acetyltransferase]], named 95 to 99%.

**A long persistent middle follows.** Columns 20 to 37, `purH` to `thiH`, are spine in 94 to 97% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 4% of calls, [[purine biosynthesis and thiamine synthesis]], named 90 to 99%. Columns 39 to 51, `rpoC` to `murI`, are spine in 96 to 97%, in a region of plasticity in 0.4 to 1%, named 94 to 99%, and no column hesitates more than 0.14 bits. The forks at columns 19 and 38 carry `yjaA` and `yjaZ`.

**The last stretch is fork and variable columns.** Columns 66 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 4% of calls, are named 74 to 98%, fewest at column 78, 74%, and most hesitant at column 67, 0.28 bits. The forks carry `pflD`, `frwB` and `metB`; the variable columns carry `frwC` to `metL`, [[pyruvate formate lyase and methionine synthesis]]. The window ends at column 79, `metB`, in 47% of chromosomes.

**Across the window the model names 96% of genes**, 0.17 bits on average. It names 98% of persistent calls, 81% of shell and 33% of cloud. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.46 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 88% against 96%.

label: hypothetical protein
facts:
WINDOW: the hypothetical protein window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hypothetical protein, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,101 to 4,180 from dnaA. Read in 534 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hypothetical protein once); 42,719 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 96% of genes, 0.17 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,794 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; shell 4,841 calls, named 81%, 0.54 bits; cloud 84 calls, named 33%, 1.41 bits. Outside an RGP 40,282 calls, named 96%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 2,437 calls, named 88%, 0.46 bits. Columns: 62 spine, 5 fork, 13 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.46 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (88% against 96%); 2,437 of the 42,719 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 13 ("PTS mannose/fructose/sorbose transporte…") 0.66 bits, RGP 42%; column 9 (pepE) 0.61 bits, RGP 38%; column 7 (yjbD) 0.58 bits, RGP 4%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 13 (fork), RGP 42%; the least: column 52 (variable), RGP 0.4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-12 (13 columns) spine: share 97-100%, all P, RGP 0-42%. Genes: "hypothetical protein", yjbH "YjbH domain-containing protein", yjbG "capsule biosynthesis GfcC family pr…", yjbF "YjbF family lipoprotein", yjbE "exopolysaccharide production protei…", pgi, lysC, yjbD "DUF3811 domain-containing protein", rluF, pepE, yjbB "Na/Pi symporter", metH, iclR. named 89-99.6% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 7 (yjbD), named 89%; most hesitant at column 9 (pepE), 0.61 bits.
2. column 13 fork: RGP 42%. named 76%; 0.66 bits.
   13: "PTS mannose/fructose/sorbose transporte…" S 42%; also espL4 S 40%, "ShET2/EspL2 family type III secretion s…" S 23%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 11%
3. columns 14-18 (5 columns) spine: share 95-98%, all P, RGP 6-42%. Genes: aceK "bifunctional isocitrate dehydrogena…", aceA, aceB, metA, yjaB "acetyltransferase". named 95-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 18 (yjaB), named 95%, 0.38 bits.
4. column 19 fork: RGP 4%. named 95%; 0.35 bits.
   19: yjaA S 49% "YjaA family stress response protein"; also "hypothetical protein" S 11%
5. columns 20-37 (18 columns) spine: share 94-97%, all P, RGP 3-4%. Genes: purH, purD, zraR, zraS, zraP "zinc resistance sensor/chaperone Zr…", yjaH "DUF1481 domain-containing protein", hupA, yjaG "DUF416 family protein", nfi, hemE, nudC, rsd, thiC, thiE "thiamine phosphate synthase", thiF, thiS, thiG, thiH. named 90-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 20 (purH), named 90%, 0.37 bits.
6. column 38 variable: RGP 2%. named 96%; 0.18 bits.
   38: yjaZ S 67% "heat-shock protein C"
7. columns 39-51 (13 columns) spine: share 96-97%, all P, RGP 0.4-1%. Genes: rpoC "DNA-directed RNA polymerase subunit…", rpoB, rplL, rplJ, rplA "50S ribosomal protein L1", rplK, nusG, secE, tuf, coaA, birA, murB, murI "glutamate racemase". named 94-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 51 (murI), named 94%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.14 bits (column 44 (rplK)).
8. column 52 variable: RGP 0.4%. named 95%; 0.14 bits.
   52: btuB S 69%
9. columns 53-65 (13 columns) spine: share 90-94%, all P, RGP 1-4%. Genes: trmA, yijD "YijD family membrane protein", fabR, sthA, oxyR, argH, argB "acetylglutamate kinase", argC, argE, ppc, eptC, yijO "AraC family transcriptional regulat…", frwD. named 93-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 62 (ppc), named 93%, 0.20 bits.
10. columns 66-79 (14 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 1-4%. named 74-98% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 78, named 74%; most hesitant at column 67, 0.28 bits.
   66 variable: pflC P 88%
   67 fork: pflD P 87% "pyruvate formate lyase family prote…"; also "MFS transporter" S 16%
   68 fork: frwB P 86% "PTS fructose-like transporter subun…"; also manD S 16%
   columns 69-78 variable, share 51-81%, 9 P, 1 S: frwC 81%, ptsP 78%, fsa 76%, gldA 72%, yijF "DUF1287 domain-containing protein" 68%, yijE 61%, katG 58%, metF 56%, "hypothetical protein" 53%, metL 51%
   79 fork: metB P 47% "PLP-dependent transferase"; also metJ P 24%, yiiX P 13%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): aceA isocitrate lyase; aceB malate synthase A; zraR response regulator; zraS ATP-binding protein; thiC phosphomethylpyrimidine synthase ThiC; thiF HesA/MoeB/ThiF family protein; thiG thiazole synthase; thiH 2-iminoacetate synthase; rplL 50S ribosomal protein L7/L12; rplJ 50S ribosomal protein L10; rplK 50S ribosomal protein L11; murB UDP-N-acetylmuramate dehydrogenase; argC N-acetyl-gamma-glutamyl-phosphate reduc…; argE M20/M25/M40 family metallo-hydrolase; pflC [formate-C-acetyltransferase]-activatin…; pflD pyruvate formate lyase family protein; frwB PTS fructose-like transporter subunit I…; metB PLP-dependent transferase; espL4 type III secretion system effector EspL4; sorE L-sorbose 1-phosphate reductase; btuB TonB-dependent receptor domain-containi…; manD enolase C-terminal domain-like protein; yiiX YiiX family permuted papain-like enzyme
END: the window ends at column 79, metB, in 47% of chromosomes.
